text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Snacks are ready to go~! Alright, let's 
start. 'Umuscle Fighter Tag'!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm! A fighting game where pairs face off 
against each other, is it... Heh, if it is 
a contest of skill, I will not pull my 
punches!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"So I just need to knock my opponent off 
the screen, right? Fufu, I'm looking 
forward to this. A friend told me about it 
recently, and I've been curious."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The war horn has sounded—now, take up your 
arms! Let our final battle begin...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Wait. First—we decide the pairs. The 
method... How about Rock-Paper-Scissors?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My, Durandal! How reassuring to have you 
as my partner!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm honored. ...Don't worry, 
Fine-san. Even if it's just a game, on my 
honor as a knight, I will protect you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Um, press the L button and... Whoa, my 
character suddenly started dancing!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't panic! That's the taunt button! 
If you want to use a special move, the 
button next to it is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wide open! Looking away on the battlefield 
will cost you your life!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kh... With this, that makes 10 consecutive 
losses...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, competitive games are pretty tough, 
huh. Sorry for making you cover for me so 
much, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not something you should 
apologize for! To think I couldn't protect 
my partner... How pathetic of me...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...All right! So that I can really be of 
help, I'll think about it a bit more. Like 
watching other people play, for example!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Playing games with everyone is fun and 
all, but I'd love to win at least once 
against Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The time is ripe. If we are to disrupt 
the battlefield, now is the moment— Are 
you ready to dance, Kris S?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. Mission: Supporting you... 
will be accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Feast your eyes! The jet-black impact of 
my destruction, sear it into your gaze!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The path is clear. —Go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(I see... Gimlet, who excels at 
destruction, acts as the vanguard, while 
the calm and composed Kris provides 
covering fire.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I got blown away so far... Ugh, I 
might lose this...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, there's no need to 
worry! Mirako, you should make use of this 
Caltrop Hell!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"If the enemy draws near, strike back with 
this! This strategy can only be entrusted 
to you... I'm counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... Mmm, alright! I'll push myself 
just a little bit more...!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm-hmm, No Reason-san is great at 
building people up, and Mirako-san is 
giving it a casual try. Those two seem to 
have great chemistry too—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“I see... What's important in this game is 
understanding each other's roles and 
sticking to them...!”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Durandal! There's something I'd like 
to try out.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*—'Lord Durandal. Your service as my 
guard thus far has been truly exemplary.'"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
! Fine-san— No, Your Highness. Your words 
are too kind...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"However, you no longer need to protect 
me. ...Stand at the front lines, and wield 
your sword."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What...!? With all due respect, if I take 
the lead, I cannot protect Your Highness. 
That would bring shame upon my name as a 
knight...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...You must not lose sight of your 
mission."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"‘Your mission is to offer victory to me. 
Not to fall in defeat after acting as a 
guard.’"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"In the name of the Princess, I command 
you. Knight Durandal—with that holy sword, 
bring us glory!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness...! Yes. My Lord's sovereign 
command is etched firmly into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Here I swear. —I will fulfill my mission, 
without fail!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even in the digital realm, my holy sword 
shall not be dimmed— Playful Flash! 
Phantasma Éclair!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwooooh! Th-This relentless assault is...! 
Ugh, I can't push forward~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal, take this Holy Grail! May holy 
divine protection be granted upon your 
swordplay!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The sword's edge... has become sharper?! 
Your Highness, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Come at me. I am the ultimate sword, 
Durandal— I shall present a glorious 
victory to Your Highness!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oops, we lost~. ...Still, you two are 
incredible. Your teamwork is just 
seamless!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu♪ 'Such glorious chivalry, 
Durandal. Your bravery shall be passed 
down through the ages.'"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am honored by your praise. I, 
Durandal... shall at all times be Your 
Highness's sword!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there are so many of them. Hmm, which 
one should I pick~?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. A game to play with Durandal♪ We 
teamed up the other day, so we promised to 
play together again."
choice_data_list: How about an action game or something?

A zombie shooter might actually be pretty 
fun

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nice! Next time, I might want to try 
fighting alongside Durandal too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For example... a fencer wielding a rapier, 
maybe? A knight and a fencer could take 
down any monster together♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Zombies, huh... I wonder if Durandal will 
be okay. Even if she's scared, she'd 
probably still try to protect me, 
though..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and when that happens, I can just 
protect you instead, right? Working 
together is what teamwork is all about!
